title: India Defence Exports Hit Record All-Time High of ₹38,424 Crore in FY26
summary: Defence exports jump 62.66% YoY to ₹38,424 Cr; DPSUs contribute 54.84% (₹21,071 Cr) and private sector 45.16% (₹17,353 Cr).

blocks.content: Ministry of Defence announced India's defence exports reached an all-time high of **₹38,424 crore in FY26** (+62.66% from ₹23,622 crore in FY25), exporting to 80+ nations.

items: **Top Exporters**: 145 registered defence exporters (up from 128). Top destinations: US, France, Armenia, Philippines.
**Target**: Government aims for **₹50,000 crore** defence exports by 2030.
